messages.label: spendState: replies allowed?
messages.note: At 100% of llm.monthlyBudgetUsd it throws budget and no provider is called. A budget of 0 or less skips the check.

messages.label: isOpen(main)?
messages.note: An open breaker skips the role. Breaker state is process-wide, not per chat.

messages.label: onCall and addSpend per attempt
messages.note: Every attempt is recorded, success or failure. Subscription transport records cost but does not count it.

messages.label: retry transient, 250ms doubling, at most 2
messages.note: Malformed gets one retry. Refusal and budget throw. The turn signal cuts waits short.

messages.label: open(role) on rate_limit or auth
messages.note: Auth also alerts the operator through onAuthFailure.

messages.label: callTarget(fallback), same request
messages.note: Same prompt and tools, fallback model. If both roles fail the turn ends with the pack error line.
